inspectedInvariants: Network mode requires IBusinessNetworkSubtypePort before consuming the attempt; old default mode rejects an unexpected Network state.

The network object/class/behaviour-array identities are nonzero, mutually distinct from all other pinned identities, and equal on subsequent reads. Bidirectional binding checks include BusinessNetworkObject, component index zero, one behaviour, and exact Business pointer.
Both Business and Network counter dictionaries are defensively copied into bounded read-only dictionaries. Counters must be nonnegative/bounded; unexpected nonzero callback names are rejected.

ReadCurrent checks revocation/context before and after port read, freezes data and checks identity plus monotonically nondecreasing frames/Business/Network counters. Retirement also goes through this common read path.
Before SetActive(true), SetActive(false), and Cleanup the trial performs fresh current-context checks; port adapters still must guard their own internal multiple native accesses.
Network activation success requires a later real Unity frame and own Awake/Start/OnEnable/FixedUpdate observations. Deadline wins over a first late successful observation.

Deactivation requires an exact single OnDisable delta for each participant; cleanup requires an exact OnDestroy delta for each participant. Unconfirmed cleanup or later evidence failure clears CleanupComplete and quarantines without retry.
On context loss the trial retains ownership and records quarantine; it does not guess at destruction or repeat a failed attempt.

Network snapshot extension preserves the original ten mandatory registry names, freezes baseline keys/values, and requires equality. Naming/identity/coverage of additional FishNet holders remain the native adapter's responsibility.
